Half-day Panama Drumming Experience 





Join the Panama Drumming Experience for an authentic dive into Panamanian folklore led by master percussionist Omar Díaz. From the moment our driver picks you up at the hotel until you’re returned at the end of the session, you’ll participate in a carefully crafted workshop designed for all skill levels, no prior experience required. You’ll learn to master the three essential drums (Repicador, Pujador and Caja) and the fundamental strokes Claro, Queme and Pujo. Under Omar’s expert guidance, you’ll explore vibrant rhythmic patterns such as Cumbia, Corrido and Tambor Norte, and take part in traditional dance accompaniments like the Tamborito, Punto Panameño and Fiesta del Torito Guapo. Along the way, you’ll uncover the cultural significance of each instrument, from the selection of fine woods and artisanal hides to the blending of African and Spanish influences. The experience features detailed explanations, hands-on demonstrations and tailored insights to help you develop your own style and carry the true pulse of Panama with you.

HALF-DAY GEISHA COFFEE EXPERIENCE IN CASCO VIEJO





Experience the soul of Panamanian coffee on an intimate, expert-led sensory journey. Your adventure begins with a tasting of Geisha coffee washed, natural and honey processed, guided by a high-altitude coffee specialist who will reveal how each method teases out the bean’s delicate aromas, silky body and bright acidity. As you savor each cup, you’ll uncover the remarkable story behind this legendary bean, from its mountain origins to its triumphs on the world stage, gaining a newfound appreciation for why Geisha is hailed as one of the finest coffees on earth. To complete the experience, indulge in artisanal desserts crafted with Geisha beans, each perfectly paired to highlight their subtle flavor notes. This thoughtfully curated excursion promises to immerse you fully in Panama’s vibrant coffee culture and leave your senses awakened.

HALF-DAY COFFEE TOUR AT FINCA DON PEPE

Pick up at the hotel, private car, to head towards the farm located on the slopes of Volcán Barú, specifically in the Volcancito area (Boquete, Chiriquí); at an altitude of 1,500 to 2,000 meters above sea level. We have 70 hectares of land: 59 for coffee cultivation and 11 for natural

HALF DAY CHOCOLATE MAKING CLASS EXPERIENCE 





Immerse yourself in the art of chocolate crafting with a workshop led by a seasoned chocolate specialist. Your journey begins with an introduction to the origins and flavor profiles of premium cacao beans, followed by hands-on roasting, winnowing and grinding to create your own bean-to-bar base. Under expert guidance, you’ll master conching techniques and the tempering process needed for a flawless, glossy finish and silky mouthfeel. Next, you’ll personalize your creation by blending in select ingredients—nuts, spices or dried fruits—before pouring the mix into artisanal molds and adding your own decorative touches. By the end of the session, you’ll walk away with half a kilo of beautifully wrapped bars and a deeper appreciation for the craftsmanship behind every bite.

FULL-DAY AZUERO FOLKLORE WITH RUM TOUR

Discover during the entire day the culture and folklore of Panama by visiting Azuero and meeting its skillful artisans who have kept their traditions (dating from the time of the conquest) intact.

Particularly, you will be able to see the making-of the so-called polleras, beautiful traditional

dresses worn in Spain during the conquest. Also, you will be able to see the local’s mastery while manufacturing the eye-catching paper mache masks, which emulate bright-colored demons or animals; generally used in traditional festivities such as Corpus Christi and Diablicos Sucios.

Likewise, you will discover the secrets of drums, the main instrument of Panamanian traditional music.

The tour continues at San Isidro Farm, where the best Panamanian rum is produced: Ron Abuelo. Visiting along the plantations, you will see the different stages of the production process: the juice extraction, its fermentation and its distillation. Later on, you will see the rum maturing process, mostly done in little oak casks until it reaches different commercialized standards: Ron Abuelo Añejo, Ron Abuelo (7 Year Old Rum) and Ron Abuelo (12 Year Old Rum), and Ron Abuelo Centuria

(30 Year Old Rum) Finally, there will be a tasting of different kinds of rum, through which you will sense their scent, aroma and intensity. The tour includes a typical Panamanian lunch.

HALF-DAY SEA TURTLE WATCHING ECO TOUR (NIGHT)

The tour starts in the afternoon with the shuttle service to the Cañas pier where you will board a powerboat which will take you to Isla Cañas. From July to January, its fourteen kilometers [8.6992 miles] seashore receives thousands of turtles, predominantly, olive ridley sea turtles that arrive to deposit their eggs. An interesting sustainable tourism project is being undertaken on the island. It arose after turtle’s eggs production and commercialization for human consumption were

forbidden; that represented, along with fishing, the sole income source of the local population.

Upon your arrival to the island, dinner will be served, prepared by local ladies. Afterwards, aboard a cart pulled by horses, you will reach the beach where you will see in detail turtles depositing

their eggs or turtles coming out of their shells. You should pay close attention to the guide’s indications to disturb the turtles as little as possible. Finally, return to the Hotel.

DURATION: 4 hours approximately

TIME: 4:30 p.m. (night-time tour), subject to confirmation. INCLUDED: Bilingual guide, transfer from/to the hotel, visits, dinner. NOTE:

Our journey begins by discovering the captivating Snail Point, also known as Punta Culebra Nature Center; you will dive into several marine exhibits showcasing the rich biodiversity of Panama’s coastal waters and have the opportunity to observe various marine species, including colorful fish, sea turtles, and fascinating invertebrates.

At Starfish Beach it’s the next stop. Immerse yourself in the crystal-clear waters and discover the breathtaking beauty of countless starfish dotting the sandy shores. This idyllic spot is perfect for sunbathing, swimming, and marveling at the wonders beneath the sea. Next, we set sail for Bird Island, a haven for avian enthusiasts.
